achievements.name: Bound Companions
achievements.detail: Leave on the journey with the companions who join your party.

achievements.name: Vision Called
achievements.detail: Bring a Vision into battle, an echo of a hero from an earlier tale.

achievements.name: Stagger
achievements.detail: Strike an enemy's weakness until it staggers. The character who did it gains a bonus action.

achievements.name: Resonance
achievements.detail: Stagger every foe in one turn, then use the Vision Resonance that follows.

achievements.name: Vision Party
achievements.detail: Enter a fight with your companions and at least two Visions together.

achievements.name: Esper
achievements.detail: Gain an esper's aid and carry that summon with you.

achievements.name: Sanctum of Light
achievements.detail: Visit a Sanctum of Light and take a vision crystal from it.

achievements.name: Airship
achievements.detail: Fly an airship from one part of the map to another.

achievements.name: Limit Burst
achievements.detail: Fill a limit gauge and unleash that character's Limit Burst.

achievements.name: Vision Awakened
achievements.detail: Spend magicite to awaken a Vision and draw out a stronger ability.

achievements.name: Mighty Foe
achievements.detail: Defeat a cavern's powerful monster and take the magicite it leaves.

achievements.name: Secret Dungeon
achievements.detail: Clear an optional dungeon that sits apart from the main story.
